items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: most of the young white carnet players were trying to get as close to Emmett Hardy as they could

ctx.x: But you knew Dick too. Oh, yeah. What did he sound like?

Sounds very good. I don't know exactly whose style I would compare him with, but I think in those days that most of the young white carnet players were trying to get as close to Emmett Hardy as they could, so I suppose their style was a little like theirs.
Do you remember Hardy? Very vaguely.
